date.as_written: svasti śrīsamvat 1935 sāla miti mārga vadi 10 roja 4 mā likhitam saṃpūrṇa

notes: Gopālavilāsī is the author of the text (Buddhiprasādinī appears to be the title of the work or its commentary), not a participant in copying; listed only for filtering. No scribe, commissioner or ruler named. Year 1935 with Nepali 'sāla', 'miti', 'roja' is Vikrama Saṃvat (= CE 1878, Mārga kṛṣṇa, Nov/Dec), consistent with the catalogue's 'SAM 1935'. The Nepali verse after the date (ntāgari || manalāi || ṣaicera || rāṣadā ...) is partly corrupt and contains no personal names.
